brand.title: Brand board
brand.intro: A working board to approve the logo, colours, typography and style before building the site. Nothing here is final.

logo.title: The logo
logo.lead: Faithfully redrawn from the official logo (900 px PNG): shapes, proportions and colours unchanged, with clean, light paths.
logo.overlay_hint: The official PNG is shown on top of the redraw: any difference appears doubled.
logo.fidelity: Measured overlap: yellow 98.9%, green 98.9%. Remaining differences ≤ 1–2 px (the cross is slightly skewed in the scanned original, anti-aliasing).
logo.notes_title: Kept exactly as in the original
logo.note_notch: The gap in the outline at the bottom left of the sail.
logo.note_cross: The cross's top arm, slightly wider than the shaft (46.7 vs 40). To confirm.
logo.note_text: The arched text, retraced letter by letter (original typeface unknown).
logo.dark_plain: A · As is — black outlines and text disappear
logo.clearspace: Clear space: the height of one “E” of the mark on every side.
logo.minsize: Minimum size: 24 px tall without text; 200 px with the arched text, which is unreadable below that.
logo.minsize_demo: The mark without text at 24, 32, 48 and 64 px
logo.lockups_lead: The mark and the parish name, in live text: one line for the tiniest spaces, two lines by default, three lines when room is short.
logo.lockup_auto_lead: One composition picks two or three lines from the width available (from 22 rem).
logo.do1: Use the files in packages/ui/brand, unmodified.
logo.do2: Keep the clear space around the logo.
logo.do3: On dark backgrounds: cream halo (B) or cream line art (C).
logo.dont1: Stretch, rotate, recolour or redraw the logo.
logo.dont2: Place the logo on a busy photo or a green background.
logo.dont3: Set the parish name in a font other than the lockups’.
logo.lr1: Two lines: “Église Évangélique du Cameroun” in full, dimmed, then “Paroisse de Nkolndongo 1” strong.
logo.lr2: Three lines, for smaller spaces: “EEC” abbreviated and dimmed, then “Paroisse de” and “Nkolndongo 1” strong.
logo.lr3: One line (“EEC NKOLNDONGO 1”) only when height is tight.
logo.lr4: The lockup picks between two and three lines by itself from the width available (from 22 rem).
logo.admin_icon: The administration has its own icon: dark only, terminal-flavoured (the sail as a green line and a blinking gold prompt).

colour.title: Colour
colour.lead: Drawn from the logo — green, yellow, black, white — then softened, with the state colours. Every text/background pair is checked (WCAG AA) in both themes.
colour.seasons_lead: A decorative tint, a text-safe tint (4.5:1) and the colour of text placed on it.
colour.change_gold: Gold on cream: 1.7:1. Gold is never used for text in the light theme; new gold-ink token for gold text and icons.
colour.change_clay: Clay on cream: 3.4:1, large text only; new clay-ink token for small text.
colour.change_focus: Focus ring: gold, plus an outer forest-green ring in the light theme (gold alone doesn't reach 3:1).
colour.change_line: Field borders: new line-strong token (3:1) so fields can be told apart.
colour.change_seasons: Seasons: a decorative tint, a text tint and an on-colour for each; lighter tints in the dark theme.
colour.change_new_seasons: Epiphany and Holy Week weren't defined: proposed gold (as Christmas) and crimson. To confirm.
colour.change_states: States: success, warning, danger and info, each with a text-safe tint and a soft background tint, passing in both themes.

type.title: Typography
type.lead: Erode for headings, Switzer for text and interface: a crisp, warm headline and calm, easy reading.
type.sample_label: Typographic sample, not information about the parish.
type.lead_text: A place to sing, pray and grow together.
type.body: Whether you're passing through or have been here all your life, there's a place for you. Come in, take a seat: the singing is about to begin.
type.quote: “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”
type.punctuation: Come as you are; there's room for everyone! A question? Write to us.
type.rule1: Headings in Erode (weights 400 to 600), text and interface in Switzer.
type.rule2: Body 17 to 18 px, line height 1.6; no running text below 14.5 px.
type.rule3: Tabular figures for times, dates and amounts.
type.rule4: Headings balance (text-wrap: balance); paragraphs avoid orphans (pretty).

shape.title: Shape, elevation and motion
shape.radius_lead: Generous but never pill-shaped: 6, 10, 14, 20 and 28 px.
shape.concentric: Concentric radii: inner radius = outer radius − padding.
shape.elevation_dark: In the dark theme: a lighter surface and a faint top highlight instead of a shadow.
shape.reduced_note: Reduced motion: no movement or animated scrolling, only short fades (≤ 150 ms).
shape.rule1: Standard radii (6, 10, 14, 20, 28 px); never pills, never squircles.
shape.rule2: Never a one-sided border. We separate with space, a tint, a full frame or the ornament.
shape.rule3: Concentric radii: inner radius = outer radius − padding.
shape.rule4: Touch targets at least 44 × 44 px; a visible focus ring everywhere.
shape.rule5: Floating navigation: bars, sidebars and sheets are lifted off the edges, rounded on every corner, with a light blur.
shape.rule6: Scrollbars are always rounded. Those inside panels (sheets, dialogs, menus, lists) float within and only appear on hover.
shape.rule7: An avatar is a circle; its container, if any, is a circle too: never a circle inside a rounded rectangle.

icons.title: Icons and illustration
icons.lead: Hugeicons, stroke-rounded only: 1.5 px, text colour, at 16, 20 and 24 px.
icons.illustration_lead: Storyset illustrations (“Cuate” style), recoloured into our palette: the accent becomes our gold, slate and greys follow the theme, skin tones become ours. One file per theme, loaded only when shown. The files are not in the repository (licence): `pnpm illos:fetch` downloads them. Credit “Illustrations: Storyset” in the footer. No looping animation.

page.intro: This is where our identity and our design system live: who we are, how we speak, how we look, and every component, animation and transition of the site. Whatever is added to the site is added here.
page.private_note: Internal page, not indexed and not linked from the site. Access will be restricted to the team in phase 02.

identity.title: Our identity
identity.lead: This guide says who we are and how we want to be recognised. It is written in the first person plural: this house belongs to everyone who comes through its doors, and a parish never speaks in an agency’s voice.
identity.draft: Proposed text, for the Parish Council to review before it is published. It describes a brand intention, not facts about the parish.
identity.essence: A parish is first of all people finding one another. Our image should make you want to come in, sit down, stay. It does not show a building: it invites a people on the move.
identity.signature: Come in, there is room. · An open house. · [TO CONFIRM: line chosen by the Council]
identity.p1: We walk together. Every face counts, every age has a place. Our images show hands, gestures, gatherings — never a staged individual.
identity.p2: We are not standing still: we walk towards God, towards one another, towards tomorrow. The site breathes, changes with the seasons of the liturgical year, and never freezes into a shop window.
identity.p3: Everything starts with a gesture: reaching out a hand. Every page says, in its own way: come, there is room for you. We invite; we never demand.
identity.look1: Forest green and gold, warm and bright, like the logo.
identity.look3: Hands, hymn books, baskets, drums: our world, drawn by us.
identity.look4: Gentle movement, always optional, never blocking.
identity.look5: A small smile in the details, never in solemn moments.

voice.title: Our voice
voice.lead: We speak the way you greet someone at the door: simply, warmly, without fuss. Ours is the voice of a “we” speaking to a respected “you”.
voice.t1: We say hello, thank you, welcome. We are not an administration.
voice.t2: Short sentences, everyday words. A teenager and a grandmother read the same page.
voice.t3: We say “vous”. We do not judge, guilt or rush anyone.
voice.t4: Even in hardship we look towards the light — without playing down the pain.
voice.e2_yes: Nothing planned that day. Come back soon, there will be news.
voice.e3_yes: Your message reached us. Thank you!
voice.e4_yes: This page wandered off, like a lost sheep. Let’s head back home.
voice.m1: Warm and direct. We reach out first.
voice.m2: Clear and factual: where, when, how. Nothing more, nothing less.
voice.m3: Livelier, brighter. Exclamation marks are allowed, one per sentence at most.
voice.m4: Quiet, slow, no humour, no exclamation marks. We accompany; we do not explain.
voice.m5: Lighter and more direct, always respectful. Never forced “youth speak”.
voice.m6: Reassuring, never blaming. We say what happened and what can be done. A small smile is welcome.
voice.r1: We address visitors and members as “vous” (formal you).
voice.r2: One idea per sentence, short sentences, action verbs.
voice.r3: We invite: “Plan a visit”, “Join us”. Never “Click here”.
voice.r4: The words of the house: service, Holy Communion, Parish Council, offering, Fête des Moissons — no jargon, no unexplained acronyms.
voice.r5: We invent nothing about the parish: a time, a name or a date comes from a validated source.
voice.r6: French typography: no-break space before “: ; ! ?” and inside « », curly apostrophe ’. Times read 09h00, amounts 5,000 FCFA.
voice.r7: We write in French first, then adapt to English — never word for word. Proper names (JAPE, Fête des Moissons) stay in French, with a short gloss the first time.
voice.sample_body: Whether you are coming for the first time or have always been here, there is a place for you. Come in, sit down: the singing is about to begin.

motion.title: Motion
motion.lead: Motion serves the story and never blocks content. Gentle, short, reversible, and always optional.
motion.rule1: Enter: fade and a small rise (8 to 16 px). Exit: faster than enter. No bounce on the interface.
motion.rule2: Only transform and opacity animate. CSS is enough for hovers and fades; GSAP loads only on pages that need it.
motion.rule3: Reduced motion or data saver: no travel, no loops, only fades of 150 ms at most, and GSAP isn’t even downloaded.
motion.rule4: All content reads before JavaScript runs.
motion.rule5: Navigation (headers, sheets, menus) unfolds more slowly: 480 ms, soft curve. Icons drift slightly in the direction of the opening.
motion.rule6: Sliding indicators (tabs) use a light spring. Disclosures (accordion) take 520 ms.

illustration.title: Illustration
illustration.lead: We draw our own images: flat, bold shapes, oversized objects, accent lines over the fills. References are inspiration only, never traced.
illustration.rule1: Our palette (green, gold, clay, cream, ink) and the season’s tint.
illustration.rule2: Four warm skin tones, mixed from one image to the next; every age, every gender.
illustration.rule3: Our world: hands, Bible, hymn book, drum, offering basket, choir robes, the hill of Nkolndongo.
illustration.rule4: Never the face of God or Christ, never caricature.
illustration.rule5: Where? Empty states, loaders, banners, seasonal heroes, 404, key moments. Elsewhere: icons.
illustration.photo: Real parish photos first; otherwise curated photos without people; otherwise illustration. Warm grade, never cold or glossy. Every photo has alt text and a credit.

components.title: Components
components.lead: Every interface element, pattern and animation of the site is documented here, with a live demo, its usage and its accessibility requirements. A component without an entry is not finished.
components.upcoming: Date picker · Data table · File upload · Audio player · Season banner · News and event cards · Pagination

icon.name: Icon
icon.desc: Stroke-rounded Hugeicons, rendered at build time: no JavaScript.
icon.use: <Icon name="calendar" size="20" />. 16, 20 or 24 px, text colour. Add the icon to packages/ui/src/icons.ts first.
icon.a11y: Decorative (aria-hidden) unless a label is given; never carries information alone.

mark.name: Mark
mark.desc: The EEC logo as inline SVG, in six variants (full, without text, mono, halo).
mark.use: <Mark variant="halo" />. Halo on dark backgrounds, mono for one colour. Minimum height 24 px.
mark.a11y: Give it a label when alone; decorative when the parish name sits next to it.

lockup.name: Lockup
lockup.desc: The mark and the parish name in live text: one, two or three lines; the church line is dimmed.
lockup.use: <SiteLockup /> (variant auto: three lines when small, two lines from 22 rem) or variant one / two / three.
lockup.a11y: Real text, readable by screen readers and translatable.

illustration.name: Illustration
illustration.desc: An original illustration as inline SVG, coloured by tokens (theme, season, skin tones).
illustration.use: <Illustration name="hymn-book-handover" animate />. Layers carry data-part attributes GSAP can target. 15 KB gzipped at most.
illustration.a11y: Decorative by default; with a title it becomes role=img. Animation stops under reduced motion.

theme.name: Theme toggle
theme.desc: Cycles device → light → dark, remembered per browser, no flash on load.
theme.use: <ThemeToggle /> in the header. A tiny <head> script applies the choice before first paint.
theme.a11y: 44 px target; the label announces the current theme; storage access is wrapped in try/catch.

verse.name: Verse
verse.desc: Our way to quote: a page from the hymn book, corner turned (the gesture of our page transitions), with the gold bookmark from our illustrations hanging from the edge and carrying the opening mark. No frame, no rule.
verse.use: <Verse mark="“" cite="Matthew 11:28">…</Verse>. One verse per screen at most. The bookmark always carries the opening mark; the reference goes in the tag.
verse.a11y: blockquote + figcaption; the decorative mark is hidden. Text and reference contrast verified.
verse.demo: “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”

ornament.name: Ornament
ornament.desc: A small hand-drawn wave between two dots, separating sections in place of a rule.
ornament.use: <Ornament /> between sections. Gold; --ornament changes it. Space around it, never a line.

docblock.name: Component entry
docblock.desc: This page’s frame: name, status, description, demo, usage, accessibility.
docblock.use: Add one <DocBlock> per component in BrandComponents.astro, with its texts in packages/i18n.
docblock.a11y: One h3 per entry; the demo sits in a labelled region.

motion_idle.name: Illustration idle animation
motion_idle.desc: Floating notes and breathing sparkles in a gentle loop; paused off-screen.
motion_idle.use: <Illustration animate /> + scripts/illustration-idle.ts. GSAP is imported dynamically, never globally.
motion_idle.a11y: Absent under reduced motion and data saver (GSAP isn’t downloaded).

button.name: Button
button.desc: Five variants, three sizes, an icon-only version. While loading the label stays and a small circular ornament (a wave between two dots) turns in front of it.
button.use: <Button variant="primary" size="lg">. One primary button per screen. 14 px radius, never a pill. Loading keeps the width (aria-busy).
button.a11y: Target at least 44 px, visible gold focus, a label is mandatory for icon-only, disabled at 50 % opacity.

fields.name: Fields: text, textarea, select
fields.desc: Label, example (placeholder, required), hint and error around the control. On focus: a 2 px green ring, a soft halo, and the label takes the colour. The dropdown is our own (a native [popover] looking like the Actions menu); a hidden <select> keeps forms working.
fields.use: <Field id label hint error>. The error says what to do, without blame. Selects never show the browser’s default look.
fields.a11y: Label tied to the control, aria-invalid and aria-describedby, error announced (role=alert), a 2 px error frame in addition to colour.

choices.name: Checkbox, radio, switch
choices.desc: Choice controls drawn by us on real <input>s: keyboard and screen readers work out of the box.
choices.use: <Choice kind="checkbox|radio|switch">. The whole row is clickable (44 px). A switch acts at once; a checkbox waits for submit.
choices.a11y: The switch has role=switch. State is never carried by colour alone: shape and position change too.

overlays.name: Dialog, sheet, menu, tooltip
overlays.desc: Dialog and sheet on native <dialog>; the sheet floats, rounded on every corner, with a discreet scrollbar. Menu and list on the popover attribute. Soft in, faster out.
overlays.use: <Dialog>, <Dialog side="end">, <Menu>, <Tooltip>. Dialog to decide, sheet to filter or navigate, menu for actions. Never a dialog over a dialog.
overlays.a11y: Focus trap, Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger, page scroll locked. Menu: arrows, Home/End. Tooltip: Esc, hover and focus.

disclosure.name: Tabs and accordion
disclosure.desc: Tabs switch views: a single indicator slides elastically from one to the next, and idle tabs light up on hover. The accordion, native on <details>, unfolds slowly and works without JavaScript.
disclosure.use: <Tabs> for 2 to 5 sibling views; <Accordion> for questions. The name attribute makes the accordion exclusive.
disclosure.a11y: Tabs: role=tablist, arrows, Home/End. Accordion: focusable summary, decorative chevron.

feedback.name: Toast, badge, skeleton
feedback.desc: A toast stacks its siblings like a deck (newest in front), spreads on hover and shows a progress ring around a large close cross, tinted by tone. State badges and skeleton complete the set.
feedback.use: toast(message,  tone ). One tone per meaning: success, warning, danger, info. Five seconds; hovering pauses.
feedback.a11y: role=status (alert for danger), labelled close button. Meaning is in the text too, not just colour.

surfaces.name: Card, avatar, empty state
surfaces.desc: Soft surfaces (20 px) on shadow 1. The empty state hosts an illustration, a kind title and an action.
surfaces.use: <Card href> becomes a whole-card link. <EmptyState>: always say what to do next.
surfaces.a11y: A link card has a single link (the whole card). The avatar is decorative when next to the name.

header.name: Site header and navigation
header.desc: A floating bar: lockup, five tabs with icons, and discreet tools (search, language, theme, account). Each tab opens a mega menu: the pages with their icon and description, and an illustration specific to the theme. Three pods in a line at the top of the page: the lockup, the tabs and the tools (search, language, theme, account). Scrolling down, they join like water droplets (driven by the scroll) into a single bar; scrolling back to the top, they part the same way. The bar then tucks away leaving a glimpse of its edge; scrolling up, hovering it (mouse) or tapping it (mobile) brings it back. On phones: two pods, the lockup and the menu button (square).
header.use: <Header /> through the Site layout. Panels open on mouse intent (120 ms), click and keyboard. The active page has a gold stroke. Every entry, even nested, carries an icon. The effect exists only at the top of the page. --merge (0 → 1) comes from the scroll (140 px); a “goo” layer (SVG filter) draws the joined shape. Reduced motion: the join is immediate, no animation.
header.a11y: aria-expanded buttons, arrows to move, Esc closes and returns focus, skip link to the content. The first tap on the tucked-away bar only brings it back (nothing underneath is activated). Keyboard focus brings it back too.
header.demo: See the header at the top of the site’s home page.

mobile.name: Mobile menu
mobile.desc: A full screen: floating cards with icons, tabs as soft accordions, tools at the bottom, a big close button within thumb reach. A slow circular reveal; the page behind does not scroll.
mobile.use: Below 1024 px, the menu button opens the <dialog>. Under reduced motion, a plain fade.
mobile.a11y: Modal <dialog>: trapped focus, Esc, focus returned. 52 px targets.

footer.name: Footer
footer.desc: A separate invitation card, then a sober floating footer (same frame as the header, rounded on every corner): the parish and the site map. Below the card: legal links, language and theme. Below the footer, a seasonal playground: depending on the liturgical season, leaves, stars, twigs, palms, flowers, flames or ears of wheat drift down as the footer nears and pile up. The pointer stirs them and throws them upwards (they fall back with weight and a little wind); a tap scatters them.
footer.use: <Footer /> through the Site layout. Drawings in lib/seasonal-art.ts, physics in scripts/playground.ts (loaded only when the footer is near, dependency-free canvas).
footer.a11y: One h2 per column, 44 px links. The playground is decorative (aria-hidden) and never required. Reduced motion or Save-Data: a still picture of the pile, no animation.
footer.demo: See the footer at the bottom of the site.

transitions.name: Page transitions
transitions.desc: A page-turn effect: the old page slides a little and fades, the new one arrives from the other side.
transitions.use: Astro ClientRouter in the Site layout. 150 ms out, 260 ms in. Scripts re-run on astro:page-load.
transitions.a11y: Reduced motion: a plain 120 ms fade. Focus and scroll are handled by the router.
transitions.demo: Navigate between two site pages to see it.

adminshell.name: Admin shell
adminshell.desc: Floating sidebar and top bar (lifted off the edges, rounded, blurred), collapsible by groups. On mobile the menu opens full screen and locks page scrolling. Same tokens and fonts as the site; a dedicated dark icon. Management screens: page header, filters, table (alternate rows tinted, never lines), panels, side sheet for forms, a confirmation that asks to type the name for a dangerous action, a copyable link (invitations, resets), a toast with “Undo”, an illustrated “Restricted” state. See /admin/ui.
adminshell.use: apps/admin. ⌘K or Ctrl+K opens quick search. The React components are shown at /ui in the admin.
adminshell.a11y: Skip link, labelled navigation, current page via aria-current, mobile drawer with a clickable scrim.
adminshell.demo: See the administration: pnpm dev then http://localhost:5173.

preloader.name: Preloader
preloader.desc: On the first visit: a small centred badge where the EEC mark draws itself stroke by stroke, then its colours fill in; a thin bar follows the drawing. The page waits for the drawing to finish (≈2 s), then rises in under the badge.
preloader.use: <Preloader /> in the base layout, with the line variant of <Mark>. The drawing lasts about 1.2 s; it never replays during navigation.
preloader.a11y: Decorative (aria-hidden), holds the content no longer than needed. Reduced motion: the line is already drawn, a plain fade.

errorscreen.name: Error page
errorscreen.desc: A single screen, no scroll: dots over the whole screen that light up around the pointer (where it is and a little around), a big code, a warm text, a primary action (back home) and a few helpful ones. The Storyset cherry tree stands at the very bottom, cropped by the screen edge. No cards.
errorscreen.use: apps/web: <ErrorScreen /> (404, both languages, the right one picked from the address or the browser). apps/admin: ErrorScreen.tsx (404 and 500). A signed-in member opening the admin sees this same 404: it does not announce itself.
errorscreen.a11y: One h1, 44 px buttons, the illustration is decorative. Reduced motion: the dots no longer follow the pointer.
errorscreen.demo: Open an address that does not exist, for example /en/oops.

picture.name: Media library photo
picture.desc: <Picture> shows a photo from the media library: several sizes (480, 960, 1600 px), the description in the page’s language, a blurred loading placeholder (ThumbHash) behind it, lazy loading. People who ask to save data get the smallest size.
picture.use: <Picture media sizes="(min-width: 64rem) 50vw, 100vw" /> with the fields /api/media returns. In the admin: Media library (drag-and-drop upload, required description, credit, archive).
picture.a11y: A description (alt) is required for every photo, empty only when the image is decorative. Dimensions are given to avoid layout shifts.
picture.demo: See the admin, Media library. No photo is used on the site yet.

marquee.name: Announcement marquee
marquee.desc: A line of short messages gliding gently, looped without a seam: for an announcement not to be missed (an event, a schedule change). One subject per message.
marquee.use: <Marquee items label pauseLabel playLabel />. Place it under the header, never more than one per page. One pass lasts 40 s by default.
marquee.a11y: Automatic motion must be stoppable (WCAG 2.2.2): pause button, pause on hover and focus, and no motion with “reduce motion” (the messages wrap). The second copy is hidden from screen readers.
marquee.demo: See above: hover or pause it.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.desc: Links to the pages of a long list: previous, numbers around the current page (“…” for the rest), next. Plain links: it works without JavaScript and every page has its own address.
pagination.use: <Pagination page pages href="/en/news/?page=N" … />: N is replaced by the page number.
pagination.a11y: Labelled <nav>, current page in aria-current, previous/next disabled at the ends, 44 px targets, the “Previous/Next” text replaced by the arrow alone on a phone.
pagination.demo: Five of twelve, and a small number of pages.

insetfields.name: Fields with inset icons
insetfields.desc: A field with an icon at the start (email, phone, search) and, for a password, an eye at the end that shows or hides the entry. The icon takes the focus colour while typing.
insetfields.use: Astro: <Field icon="mail" /> and <Field type="password" toggle (show / hide labels) />. React: <TextField icon="mail" /> and <PasswordField /> in the admin.
insetfields.a11y: The icon is decorative (aria-hidden). The eye is a real, named button (“Show password” / “Hide…”) with aria-pressed, reachable by keyboard.
insetfields.demo: Try the eye of the password field.

search.name: Search
search.desc: A search field with the magnifier inside and a button. The form carries role="search".
search.a11y: Visible label, example text that does not repeat the label, 44 px button, Enter runs the search.
search.demo: The search engine arrives with the content.

imagery.name: Imagery
imagery.desc: A photo in a frame: rounded corners, a fixed ratio (nothing jumps while loading), a tinted background if the photo is missing, a caption below, a credit on the photo, a gentle zoom on hover. For real photos from the media library, use <Picture>.
imagery.use: <Figure src alt ratio="4/3" caption credit zoom />. Ratios: 1/1, 4/3, 3/2, 16/9, 3/4.
imagery.a11y: Alternative text required (empty only when the image is decorative), visible credit, zoom off with “reduce motion”.

tables.name: Tables
tables.desc: A calm table: every other row tinted, never rules, a very pale green on hover, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures, horizontal scrolling on a phone (never the page).
tables.use: <div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"> with <caption>, <th scope>. Class .num for numbers.
tables.a11y: Caption, headers with scope, the first cell of a row as <th scope="row">, AA contrast in light and dark.

charts.name: Charts
charts.desc: Chart.js charts (line, bar, doughnut) in the system’s colours, light and dark, loaded only when they scroll into view (the library weighs nothing on any other page). Always accompanied by the numbers in a table.
charts.use: Chart.js 4 loaded on demand; colours read from the tokens (--primary, --gold…). In the admin, the headcount curve stays SVG (lighter).
charts.a11y: Every chart has a description (aria-label) and an equivalent table. Animation off with “reduce motion”. Colour is never the only signal.

shapes.name: Art shapes
shapes.desc: The shapes that cut photos and illustrations (blob, windows, blocks, flower, leaf, drop, arch, sail…), defined in relative units so they fit any frame. Each page has its own composition.
shapes.use: lib/shapes.ts: a ratio (ar) and a path (defs) per shape; clip-path: url(#id) with clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox".
shapes.a11y: Decorative: the content and alternative text are those of the cut image; no information is carried by the shape.

contentcard.name: Content card
contentcard.desc: The card for any list of content (news today; events and guides next): photo, date, title, summary. The whole card is one link; the first post can be featured, shown large. It lifts gently on hover.
contentcard.use: <ContentCard item href featured? />. Photos come from the media library through <Picture>. The group and the « Featured » pin show when present.
contentcard.a11y: One link per card (the title) with an extended hit area, visible focus around the whole card, no motion with reduced motion.
contentcard.demo_text: An example summary in one sentence, for the list.

unavailable.name: Content unavailable
unavailable.desc: What a visitor sees when the database is slow or unreachable: plain words and a « Try again » button. Never an error page (decision 0027).
unavailable.use: <UnavailableState /> in place of the list or text. The page answers 503 and is not cached.

langfallback.name: Language note
langfallback.desc: When a text does not exist in English yet, the French version is shown with this note above the title.
langfallback.use: <LangFallbackNote /> when the API returns fallback = true.
langfallback.a11y: role=note, contrast checked in both themes.

editor.name: Text editor (admin)
editor.desc: A simple editor for writers: bold, italic, section heading, lists, quote, link, library photo, undo/redo. It produces only what the site can display; it loads only when someone writes (never on the public site).
editor.use: Lazy import of @eec/content-kit/editor. The text is a small JSON document (@eec/core richtext), cleaned again on the server.
editor.a11y: Labelled toolbar, 44 px buttons with pressed state, text area announced as such, links refused unless https, mailto or tel.
editor.demo: Open a news post in the admin to try it.

publishflow.name: Draft, publish, versions
publishflow.desc: The flow shared by all content: autosave (« Saved »), a Publish button (now or on a date, with an optional end date), a secret 3-day preview link, restorable earlier versions, archiving. Status labels are the same everywhere.
publishflow.use: @eec/content-kit: useAutosave, SaveIndicator, PublishDialog, RevisionsDrawer, StatusBadge, CoverField, MediaPicker, ConfirmDialog.
publishflow.a11y: Status announced with aria-live, dialogs with focus trap and Esc, problems before publishing listed in plain words.
publishflow.demo: Visible in the admin, on every news post.

generatedbanner.name: Banner generated
generatedbanner.desc: An abstract pattern in the event type’s colours, used when an event has no image. It carries the type icon and stays decorative.
generatedbanner.use: <GeneratedBanner kind="culte" /> at the top of an event page without a photo.
generatedbanner.a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden, no information carried by colour alone.

guardeddialog.name: Guarded dialog
guardeddialog.desc: A form dialog that asks for confirmation before discarding changes (Esc, outside click, Close button).
guardeddialog.a11y: Focus trapped, Esc works, the confirmation receives focus.

viewtoggle.name: View toggle
viewtoggle.desc: Two or three icon-and-label buttons to switch views (list / grid, list / month). On the public site the change happens without reloading the page.
viewtoggle.use: <ViewToggle> in the admin; data-ev-nav links on the events page.
viewtoggle.a11y: aria-current on the active view; without JavaScript they are plain links.

shortcuttip.name: Shortcut tooltip
shortcuttip.desc: On hover or focus of a button, a bubble shows its name and keyboard shortcut as styled keys (Kbd).
shortcuttip.use: <ShortcutTip label="Bold" keys="Ctrl B"> around a button.
shortcuttip.a11y: Also shown on keyboard focus; the button keeps its aria-label.

fullscreeneditor.name: Full-screen editor
fullscreeneditor.desc: The text editor goes full screen without losing content: fixed toolbar with labels, document title with a back button, word and character counts.
fullscreeneditor.use: The editor’s full-screen button; the back arrow or Esc leaves it.
fullscreeneditor.a11y: Menus and dialogs open above the full-screen layer; reduced motion removes the animation.

weektoc.name: Week index
weektoc.desc: On the events page a sticky index lists the weeks shown and highlights the one on screen. Hidden on mobile.
weektoc.use: Appears from three weeks; anchor links #ev-<date>.
weektoc.a11y: Labelled navigation, aria-current on the visible week.

fliptime.name: Flip-card time
fliptime.desc: A time as two soft cards (hours, minutes), no divider: used for the service time on the “This Sunday” card and page.
fliptime.use:
09:00

; size with --flip-size.
fliptime.a11y: The container carries the full time as its aria-label; the cards are aria-hidden.

tablepicker.name: Table size picker
tablepicker.desc: In the editor, a hover grid (8 × 8) previews the size; rows and columns can also be typed (up to 30 × 10).
tablepicker.use: The editor’s Table button; click a cell or “Insert”.
tablepicker.a11y: The grid is for the mouse; keyboard users use the rows and columns fields.

deptcard.name: Group card and quiz
deptcard.desc: A card (photo, name, tagline, audience) per group, filterable; the “Where do you belong?” quiz goes question by question with a progress bar.
deptcard.use: Departments page; the whole card is a link. The quiz stores nothing.
deptcard.a11y: Filters are links (work without JavaScript); progress is announced (progressbar); focus moves to each new question.

guidechecklist.name: Step checklist
guidechecklist.desc: A guide as expandable steps, with tick boxes, a progress bar, printing and reset. Ticks stay in the browser.
guidechecklist.use: Practical life pages; printing opens every step.
guidechecklist.a11y: Steps are <details> (full keyboard); one labelled box per step; a plain list without JavaScript.

historyclimb.name: Climbing the hill
historyclimb.desc: The history timeline: a winding trail draws itself as you scroll (GSAP, loaded on this page only) through the milestones, each expandable.
historyclimb.use: Our story page, from the milestones published in the admin.
historyclimb.a11y: Without animation (reduced motion, Save-Data): a plain timeline with the trail already drawn, everything readable. No scroll pinning.

councilcard.name: Council card
councilcard.desc: A person (photo, name, title, term) or, without recorded consent, the role alone.
councilcard.use: Pastors and Council page, grouped by role.
councilcard.a11y: No personal data is sent to the browser without consent.

liveswap.name: Filters without reload
liveswap.desc: On the agenda, departments and news, changing view, filter or page replaces only the results; the address and Back button follow.
liveswap.use: data-live-area region, data-live-nav links (data-live-scroll for pagination).
liveswap.a11y: Without JavaScript they are plain links. Focus and scroll position are kept.

searchdialog.name: Site search
searchdialog.desc: The header magnifier opens a dialog: results appear as you type; Enter goes to the full results page, grouped by type, with highlighted excerpts (accent- and case-insensitive).
searchdialog.a11y: Native dialog (focus trapped, Esc); results announced (aria-live); works without JavaScript through the GET form.

contactform.name: Contact form
contactform.desc: Name, e-mail or phone, subject, message and an unticked consent. Anti-spam without a third party: a hidden trap field, a minimum fill time, a per-address limit.
contactform.use: <ContactForm subject="…" /> on the Find us page; the subject comes from the “Ask a question” link.
contactform.a11y: Every field is labelled; errors are announced (role=status); the prayer request says it is confidential.

givingcard.name: Giving card
givingcard.desc: One card per method (MTN, Orange, bank): merchant, number, a “Copy the number” button and, on phones, a link to dial the merchant code. Nothing shows until the value is approved.
givingcard.use: Give page, from Settings → Giving; USSD code: tel: with # encoded as %23.
givingcard.a11y: The button says “Copied”; the dial link only appears on touch screens.

directions.name: Directions links
directions.desc: Approved address and three links: the phone’s maps app (geo:), Google Maps, OpenStreetMap. No embedded map: no third-party data loaded.
directions.use: Find us page, from the approved coordinates in settings.
directions.a11y: Clear links with the “new tab” icon; the geo: link is hidden on desktop.

todopanel.name: To do
todopanel.desc: On the admin home: what is waiting for the signed-in person (new messages, their drafts, this week’s publications, empty Sundays, times to approve, missing English titles), filtered by their rights.
todopanel.use: <TodoPanel />; each line leads to the module concerned.
todopanel.a11y: A list of links; hidden when nothing is waiting.

policynotice.name: “The policy has changed” notice
policynotice.desc: In My space, a gentle notice with the summary of changes; an “I accept” button only appears when the purposes changed.
policynotice.use: My space → My data; fed by the latest published privacy version.
policynotice.a11y: role=status; link to the new policy.

insightcards.name: Key-points cards
insightcards.desc: Three or five cards (otherwise none) summing up a document’s main points: slightly stacked, fanned on a gentle arc, cropped at the bottom; hover spreads them. Same family as the dashboard cards.
insightcards.use: <InsightCards items="…" /> on privacy and the legal notice, built from the document’s headings.
insightcards.a11y: Each card links to its section; the arrangement is decorative, the content stays readable.

inbox.name: Inbox layout
inbox.desc: Messages grouped by week then by month on one side, the open message on the other (instead of a modal). On a small screen, one pane at a time.
inbox.a11y: List as navigation; active row with aria-current; Back button on small screens.

todocards.name: To-do cards
todocards.desc: Cards ranked by urgency — urgent (red), needs attention (amber), good to know (blue) — each with the icon of its screen and a count.
todocards.a11y: The level is said in words and with an icon, never by colour alone.

conversation.name: Conversational form
conversation.desc: A form in four short steps: the need (big tiles), the message (starting phrases), how to reply, a last look. One question at a time, with progress and back.
conversation.a11y: Each step is a fieldset with a legend; focus moves to the new question; errors are announced.

searchhints.name: Search hints and actions
searchhints.desc: Empty box: what you can search, words to try, direct actions and real suggestions from the site. No result: “Did you mean…”. Search forgives typos.
searchhints.a11y: Suggestions are ordinary links; the actions list is a list of links.

areachart.name: Smooth area charts
areachart.desc: Smoothed curves (no overshoot) with a gradient under the line, rounded ends, rounded bars and a round-ended donut; every chart has a table of its numbers (months written out with the year) in a fold that opens smoothly.
areachart.use: <AreaChart>, <BarChart>, <Donut>, <ChartCard> in the admin; colours by tokens.
areachart.a11y: Each chart has a name (role=img) and an equivalent table; tooltips are <title>.

mapillustration.name: Drawn map
mapillustration.desc: An illustrated map, not a real one: the hill’s contour lines, a stream, roads, blocks and the parish marker, with the Google Maps button on top. No third-party data loaded. Once the drawing is complete, a click on the building makes it bounce (the building only); no effect with “reduce motion”.
mapillustration.use: <MapIllustration name href label /> on Find us.
mapillustration.a11y: Decorative (aria-hidden); the address and the button carry the information.

designbanner.name: Design guide banner
designbanner.desc: In the admin, a full banner: an illustration, cards and UI pieces floating at three depths (near and blurred, far and blurred, sharp) and one call to action to the guide.
designbanner.a11y: The floating pieces are decorative (hidden from screen readers and the pointer); the button is an ordinary link.

validatecard.name: “To validate” card
validatecard.desc: A piece of information waiting to be checked: its current value, then Validate, Ask for a correction or Leave a note, with links to the field and to the public page. Open corrections stay visible until they are handled.
validatecard.use: Admin → À valider; .admin-panel with primary, secondary and ghost buttons; grouped by page.
validatecard.a11y: Each group is a named section; buttons have written labels; the message box has a hint; validation is announced by a toast.

helplayout.name: Help guide
helplayout.desc: A narrow reading column for step-by-step guides: Erode title, numbered steps, a note box, and for cheat sheets a Print button (the printed sheet keeps only the text, no menu).
helplayout.use: Admin → Aide; .help-article, .help-body, .help-note; the top-bar “?” leads to the guide for the current screen.
helplayout.a11y: Ordered headings, real lists, underlined links; the “?” has a name (“Help for this screen”); print is black on white.

healthcard.name: Health card
healthcard.desc: A check with its state as a green, orange or red badge, a figure in words (“12 MB of 512 MB (2 %)”) and, when not green, a sentence saying what to do.
healthcard.use: Admin → Santé; <Badge tone="success|warning|danger">; orange starts at 70 % of a free limit.
healthcard.a11y: The state is written (“All good”, “Keep an eye on it”, “Action needed”), never colour alone; the summary is announced (role=status).

visitscharts.name: Visits without tracking
visitscharts.desc: Thirty days of page views by language (soft area chart), phone or computer (donut) and the most read pages, with the sentence saying no cookie, IP address or identifier is used. Until the counter is switched on, a single box says so.
visitscharts.use: Dashboard; <AreaChart> with days (“15 Oct”), <Donut>, ordered list; decision 0038.
visitscharts.a11y: Each chart has its table of numbers and a name; the page list is an ordered list.

sharecard.name: Share card
sharecard.desc: The image shown when a link is shared (WhatsApp, Facebook): the mark, the parish name and the section title, in Erode, in our colours. One card per section and language; a post or event uses its own photo.
sharecard.use: apps/web/public/og/*.jpg, 1200×630, drawn by scripts/og-generate.ts (rerun if the name or tagline changes); og:* tags in Base.astro.
sharecard.a11y: The image has alt text (the parish name); it carries nothing that is not also on the page.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.desc: The small dark bubble naming an icon button: it appears after a short pause on mouse hover and as soon as the button gets keyboard focus, instead of the browser’s grey tooltip.
tooltip.use: A data-tip="text" attribute on the button (data-tip-end at the right edge, data-tip-start at the left, data-tip-above to open upwards); keep aria-label. No JavaScript, public site and admin.
tooltip.a11y: The accessible name stays the aria-label; the bubble is a visual aid (never the only information). No bubble on touch; reduced motion: no transition.

helpsheet.name: Help sheet
helpsheet.desc: The guide for the current screen in a side sheet over it: nothing moves behind, so closing it leaves you exactly where you were. An abstract banner (different each time) carries the title, the reading time and “For you”. Top: “All help” on the left, close on the right.
helpsheet.use: Admin: the top-bar “?”; <HelpSheet>, <AbstractBanner seed>; the Help page remains a page of its own.
helpsheet.a11y: Modal dialog (focus trapped, Escape closes, focus returns to the “?”); title and description linked; the banner is decorative (aria-hidden).

abstractbanner.name: Abstract banner
abstractbanner.desc: A header image drawn on the fly, no photo: waves, rings, dots, blocks, arcs or stripes, in a palette taken from our colours (light and dark follow). Each opening draws another composition; nothing is stored.
abstractbanner.use: <AbstractBanner seed> (React, admin); six compositions, five palettes; colours by tokens only.
abstractbanner.a11y: Decorative (aria-hidden); text over it sits on a veil that keeps contrast in both themes.

healthstrip.name: Health strip
healthstrip.desc: Seven bars, one a day, green, orange or red (grey: no check), like a service status page, with the large status banner and, per check, a week curve or gauge.
healthstrip.use: Admin → Santé, as cards or a list (remembered view toggle); .health-strip, .health-meter, .health-banner.
healthstrip.a11y: Each bar has text (day and state) for screen readers and a tooltip; the state is written, never colour alone.

prioritychip.name: Priority chip
prioritychip.desc: A small label with an icon, words and a colour (high, keep an eye, not urgent) to say what matters first; the most urgent card also carries a soft red frame.
prioritychip.use: .prio .prio-high|medium|low; To validate, modelled on the “To do” cards.
prioritychip.a11y: Icon + text + colour: never colour alone; contrast checked in both themes.

helpgrid.name: Help grid
helpgrid.desc: The Help page as cards: one icon per guide in a tinted tile, the title in Erode and a summary line; guides matching your rights come first.
helpgrid.a11y: Each card is a link with its title; the icon is decorative.

sermoncard.name: Sermon card
sermoncard.desc: A card for a sermon: an image (the chosen photo, else a drawn banner), the date, series, title in Erode, passages, the preacher (only with consent) and “Video” / “Listen” tags. The whole card is one link.
sermoncard.use: Public → Sermons; .sc; series, preacher, book and year filters in a GET form (no JavaScript needed; with it, only the results change).
sermoncard.a11y: The title is the link (stretched over the card); tags have an icon and text; reduced motion: no lift.

videofacade.name: Video “facade”
videofacade.desc: A “Play the video” button on our own image. Nothing is requested from YouTube before the press; then only the privacy-enhanced player (youtube-nocookie.com) loads, in place.
videofacade.use: <div data-sermon-video data-id> + scripts/sermon-video.ts; the security policy only allows youtube-nocookie.com as a frame.
videofacade.a11y: A real button, keyboard operable; the frame has a title; the note says where the video comes from.

outboundlinks.name: Outbound links
outboundlinks.desc: “Listen or download” links: an icon, the name the team gave and, below, the site the link leads to (“Opens on drive.google.com”). The link opens in a new tab; the page loads nothing from that site.
outboundlinks.use: .sd-link; https addresses only, never required; decision 0034.
outboundlinks.a11y: The link name is visible and so is the host; rel="noopener noreferrer"; 56 px tall target.

meditationcard.name: Meditation of the day
meditationcard.desc: The day’s card: the date, the feast’s title if any, each reading in its tile (Old Testament, Epistle, Gospel), the psalm apart, and the verse of the day when its text was typed. Previous / next day without reloading.
meditationcard.use: Public → Meditations and bulletin; .md-today; references only (decision 0032).
meditationcard.a11y: A list of readings; the date is a heading; navigation buttons are written; the current day is marked aria-current.

weekstrip.name: Week strip
weekstrip.desc: Seven days, Monday to Sunday, each with its weekday, number and first reading; the chosen day is filled, today is ringed in gold.
weekstrip.use: .md-week-grid, .md-day; links that only change the results area.
weekstrip.a11y: Each day is a link; aria-current="date"; colour is never the only signal.

csvimport.name: Checked CSV import
csvimport.desc: A file or pasted text is read in the browser; a report says how many days, which lines have an error (blocking) or a warning, and shows the first days before anything is written.
csvimport.use: Admin → Meditations → Import; readMeditationCsv in @eec/core; the server checks each row again.
csvimport.a11y: The report is announced (role=status); each problem has an icon, text and its line.

printbulletin.name: Printable bulletin
printbulletin.desc: The week’s bulletin as a reading page, with an A4 or A5 choice: when printing, the menu, footer and buttons disappear and the page takes the chosen size (no PDF made by the server).
printbulletin.use: .bl, @page a4 / a5 (named page); ?format=a5; the browser’s “Save as PDF”.
printbulletin.a11y: Ordered headings, sections as lists; print is black on white; actions are not printed.

segmented.name: @eec/ui/astro/Segmented.astro ; <nav aria-label>, aria-current="true" sur le choix actif ; hauteur 44 px.
segmented.desc: @eec/ui/astro/Segmented.astro; <nav aria-label>, aria-current="true" on the active choice; 44 px tall.
segmented.use: Navigation par liens : Tab puis Entrée ; le choix actif est annoncé « page courante ».
segmented.a11y: Link navigation: Tab then Enter; the active choice is announced as the current page.

passagefields.name: RefEditor, ChapterVerseFields (@eec/content-kit) ; ReadingEditor, PsalmEditor (modules/meditations) ; limites : @eec/core (chapterCount, verseCount).
passagefields.desc: RefEditor, ChapterVerseFields (@eec/content-kit); ReadingEditor, PsalmEditor (modules/meditations); limits: @eec/core (chapterCount, verseCount).
passagefields.use: Chaque champ est étiqueté ; l’erreur est annoncée (role="alert") ; les limites sont écrites en placeholder (1–21).
passagefields.a11y: Every field is labelled; the error is announced (role="alert"); the limits are written as placeholders (1–21).

printletterhead.name: .print-letterhead (Site.astro) ; .help-letterhead (admin) ; toujours le Lockup, jamais le logomark seul.
printletterhead.desc: .print-letterhead (Site.astro); .help-letterhead (admin); always the Lockup, never the logomark alone.
printletterhead.use: Décoratif pour les lecteurs d’écran (aria-hidden) ; le titre du document reste le premier titre.
printletterhead.a11y: Decorative for screen readers (aria-hidden); the document title stays the first heading.

sourcepicker.name: CheckboxField + .bulletin-nodata (modules/bulletin).
sourcepicker.use: Cases à cocher natives de la charte ; le message vide est un paragraphe suivi d’un lien.
sourcepicker.a11y: Design-system checkboxes; the empty message is a paragraph followed by a link.

foldrow.name: .med-row, .med-collapse[data-open] (grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr) ; aria-expanded sur le bouton ; contenu replié en inert.
foldrow.desc: .med-row, .med-collapse[data-open] (grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr); aria-expanded on the button; folded content is inert.
foldrow.use: Le bouton annonce son état ; le contenu replié n’est pas atteignable au clavier.
foldrow.a11y: The button announces its state; folded content cannot be reached by keyboard.

retentionchip.name: .reg-retention[data-level] ; retentionLevel() dans @eec/core.
retentionchip.use: Texte complet lu tel quel ; icône décorative.
retentionchip.a11y: Full text is read as is; the icon is decorative.

checkinlist.name: .reg-checkin, aria-pressed.
checkinlist.use: Boutons à bascule (aria-pressed) ; l’état est écrit (« Présent »).
checkinlist.a11y: Toggle buttons (aria-pressed); the state is written (“Present”).

registerform.name: RegistrationPage.astro, RegistrationCancelPage.astro ; Choice, Field.
registerform.use: Libellés liés, erreurs en role="alert", groupes radio nommés.
registerform.a11y: Linked labels, errors with role="alert", named radio groups.

basket.name: CampaignPage.astro (.cp-basket, --fill) ; role="img" + aria-label.
basket.use: Équivalent texte : légende « La corbeille se remplit : n % de l’objectif » et le montant en toutes lettres.
basket.a11y: Text equivalent: the caption “The basket is filling: n% of the goal” and the amount in full.

offlinepage.name: src/sw/sw.js, OfflinePage.astro, scripts/pwa.ts ; /fr/hors-ligne/ · /en/offline/.
offlinepage.use: La mention est un status ; la liste est une liste de liens.
offlinepage.a11y: The notice is a status; the list is a list of links.

installentry.name: [data-install], [data-install-ios] ; beforeinstallprompt.
installentry.use: Un vrai bouton, nommé par son texte.
installentry.a11y: A real button, named by its text.

taginput.name: TagInput (@eec/content-kit).
taginput.use: Les pastilles sont des boutons ; l’erreur est annoncée (role="alert").
taginput.a11y: Chips are buttons; the error is announced (role="alert").

sundaychips.name: .sun-chip (modules/sundays) ; SUNDAY_PURPOSES (@eec/core).
sundaychips.use: Radio nommé « Objet » ; la pastille cochée est surlignée et en gras.
sundaychips.a11y: Radio group named “Purpose”; the checked chip is highlighted and bold.

trendbars.name: .sun-bar, .sun-num (apps/admin).
trendbars.use: Chaque barre a un équivalent texte (role="img" + aria-label) et ses chiffres.
trendbars.a11y: Each bar has a text equivalent (role="img" + aria-label) and its numbers.

notificationbell.name: Notification bell
notificationbell.desc: In the top bar, a bell (bell-ring) with the unread count. It opens a panel: Unread / All, reminders grouped by week (This week, Last week, Week of … to …), each with a deep link to the screen concerned, a red dot while unread, a tick once done, and a cross to hide it.
notificationbell.use: <NotificationsBell> in the top bar; each notification has a kind and parameters, the text is written by the screen, never stored.
notificationbell.a11y: The button announces the unread count; the panel is a titled dialog; every notification and its cross are 44 px buttons; Esc closes it.

rules.title: Rules and upkeep
rules.lead: These rules keep the system coherent. Some are checked automatically on every code check.
rules.auto1: No one-sided border, no squircle (pnpm lint).
rules.auto2: Every text/background pair meets WCAG AA in both themes (pnpm contrast, unit test).
rules.auto3: French and English have exactly the same text keys.
rules.auto4: CSS tokens are generated from a single file and checked for freshness.
rules.manual1: Light and dark, French and English, at 320 px wide.
rules.manual2: Keyboard only: visible focus, Esc closes overlays.
rules.upkeep: Every new colour, component, animation, transition or rule is added to this page in the same change as the code. Texts are written in French first. An important decision also gets a record in docs/decisions.

patterns.title: Page patterns
patterns.lead: The larger blocks that give the public pages their character. Each page has its own idea; these patterns are the shared vocabulary.

stream.name: Card stream (home)
stream.desc: A deck of tilted cards, portrait and landscape mixed, drifting slowly across the screen: the community in photos and word cards (Sing, Pray…). On hover the stream eases to a stop (its speed is damped, not cut), the card straightens, grows a little and shows its caption; a light follows the pointer.
stream.use: <HeroStream />. Pexels photos of people exist only in development; production shows word cards only until real parish photos (with consent) arrive.
stream.a11y: “Pause” button (WCAG 2.2.2), also pauses on hover. Reduced motion: no drift, a row to swipe with snap points. Save-Data: starts paused. The track copy is aria-hidden.

bento.name: Bento cards and pointer light
bento.desc: A grid of cards of different sizes, one idea each. On hover the card lifts and a soft glow in the season colour follows the pointer (data-glow attribute).
bento.use: class="bento-card" + data-glow; one card = one whole link. 6-column grid on tablet and desktop, one column on phones.
bento.a11y: The whole card is a link with a heading; the glow is decorative. Fine pointers only.

magnetic.name: Magnetic button
magnetic.desc: The main button leans a few pixels towards the pointer and springs back when it leaves.
magnetic.use: Add data-magnetic to one button per screen, the main action.
magnetic.a11y: Fine pointers only; off with reduced motion. Changes neither size nor hit area.

ring.name: Liturgical year strip
ring.desc: The year as a strip: one segment per season at its real length this year (computed from Easter), the current season in full colour, a marker for today and the next season with a countdown.
ring.use: <SeasonStrip />. Season colours from tokens; follows the theme.
ring.a11y: role=img with a label naming the current season; the next season is written out.

figures.name: Key figures
figures.desc: Large figures in Erode that count up once when they enter the screen.
figures.use: These are facts: they come from home page texts (Site pages → Home) and only appear once published, that is validated (decision 0039). An unpublished figure stays hidden everywhere.
figures.a11y: Definition list (dl); the count-up is not announced and doesn’t play with reduced motion.

account.name: Account card (My space)
account.desc: One card, two tabs (create an account / sign in), never two forms side by side. Sign-up takes three short steps with a progress bar; consents are never pre-ticked.
account.use: AccountView.astro. Google will come first (button present, “Soon”); email stays available.
account.a11y: Keyboard tabs (arrow keys), step announced (aria-live), errors under each field linked with aria-describedby, focus moves to the first field in error.

pagehero.name: Page hero (PageHero)
pagehero.desc: Every page has its own hero: the title centered, then a row of shapes (blocks, windows, drop, flower, leaf, sail…) that runs partly past the first screen — 1 shape on phones (wider than the screen, cropped left and right), 2 on tablets, 3 on laptops, 4 on large displays. Cards are placed over them at chosen spots (some overflow sideways or below, never above) and drift gently with the pointer, each at its own depth. Three pages open on a full-screen photo behind the navbar that settles into a framed rectangle on scroll. No illustrations in heroes.
pagehero.use: lib/heroes.ts: layout (split-right, split-left, centered, morph, plain), shape (lib/shapes.ts), photos and cards with their position in % of the picture. Figures are facts: null until validated (example shown in development, hidden in production). Without a photo, the shape keeps its form on a tinted panel.
pagehero.a11y: One h1 per page. Cards on solid surfaces (contrast guaranteed). On phones the shape sits above and the cards below, overlapping slightly. The scroll effect (CSS scroll-driven) is absent with reduced motion and in browsers without support: the final shape is shown directly.

pagebody.name: Page body
pagebody.desc: The content under the hero: numbered sections, a sticky heading on the left and editorial text on the right (drop cap on the first), lists as check cards, bento cards, verses in a wide gold band — long texts (the Creed) light up phrase by phrase as you scroll.
pagebody.use: PageView.astro, from the blocks in lib/pages.ts.
pagebody.a11y: h1 → h2 → h3 hierarchy, decorative numbers (aria-hidden), no scroll lighting with reduced motion.

histoire.lead: A parish is a story written by faces: those who sowed, those who kept watch, those who arrive today.
histoire.s1_p1: Nkolndongo means the hill. Our story is told like a climb: one step after another, with those walking beside us.
histoire.s1_p2: We are gathering the parish’s memories with care: accounts, photographs, testimonies. Nothing is published before it has been checked and, when it concerns people, agreed to by them.
histoire.s2_t: Do you have a memory to share?
histoire.s2_p: An old photo, a story, the name of someone who mattered: entrust them to the parish. Every detail helps keep memory alive.

croyances.lead: We are an evangelical Christian church: we believe God loves us and has made himself known in Jesus Christ.
croyances.s1_p: Since the early centuries, Christians around the world have confessed these few lines together. They say the heart of the faith.
croyances.creed: I believe in God, the Father almighty, creator of heaven and earth. I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried; he descended to the dead. On the third day he rose again; he ascended into heaven, he is seated at the right hand of the Father, and he will come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and the life everlasting. Amen.
croyances.c1_p: The Word of God, which lights and guides us. We read it, listen to it, share it.
croyances.c2_p: Salvation is a gift from God, not a wage. We receive it with gratitude.
croyances.c3_p: Speaking to God as to a Father, alone or together, in joy and in hardship.
croyances.c4_p: No one believes alone. The Church is a family where everyone carries and is carried. Baptism and Holy Communion are its signs.
croyances.note: This is a simple summary, not the Church’s full confession of faith: the Parish Council will add its reference texts.

pasteurs.lead: A parish is served by people who give their time, their listening and their faith.
pasteurs.s1_p: Everyone has a role, no one rules: we serve together and decide together about the parish’s affairs.
pasteurs.r1_p: Proclaims the Word, celebrates the sacraments, accompanies everyone in joys and hardships.
pasteurs.r2_p: Watch over the parish’s spiritual life and support the pastor.
pasteurs.r3_p: Serve people: visiting, mutual help, attention to the most vulnerable.
pasteurs.r4_p: Teach the faith to children, young people and those preparing for baptism.
pasteurs.r5_p: Brings leaders together to take the decisions of parish life together.
pasteurs.s3_p: The team’s names and portraits will be published here with each person’s agreement.

trouver.l1: Come as you are: there is no required dress.
trouver.l2: Don’t hesitate to ask the way: someone will gladly guide you.
trouver.l4: Listen, sing if you wish, and ask your questions afterwards: we love questions.

cultes.l3: The Bible reading and the message

departements.lead: Everyone has a place. The parish groups let you serve, learn and share according to your age and gifts.
departements.g1_p: Song carries the parish’s praise. You come to sing and stay for the friendship.
departements.g2_p: A space for young people: learn, talk, serve, have fun, grow in faith.
departements.g3_p: The parish’s women support one another, pray together and serve the community.
departements.g4_p: Children and those preparing for baptism discover the faith step by step.
departements.s2_p: Soon, a short three-question quiz will help you find the group that suits you. Meanwhile, come and ask.

pratique.lead: Life’s big moments are better lived accompanied. Here is how the parish walks with you.
pratique.c1_p: Being baptised, or having your child baptised: it all begins with a meeting with the pastor, to talk about what it means.
pratique.c2_p: Marrying in church means placing your commitment before God and before the community. A time of preparation with the pastor comes before the celebration.
pratique.c3_p: When someone close leaves us, the parish is there: to pray with the family, to accompany, and to arrange a time of remembrance.
pratique.c4_p: Joining the parish starts with meeting and discovering one another. Come, talk to someone: the rest follows.
pratique.note: The exact steps (documents, timelines, who to contact) will be detailed here, step by step, with the parish office.

liturgie.season_pentecote: The Holy Spirit is given: the Church is born and sets out.
liturgie.season_ordinaire: The time of everyday life: we learn to follow Jesus, day after day.
liturgie.season_moissons: A time of gratitude for what the earth gives, and of sharing.

give.lead: Giving is a way of saying thank you: to God for what he gives us, and to others by sharing.
give.s1_p: Offerings and gifts keep the parish and its projects alive: worship, welcome, upkeep of the place, service to others. Every gift, small or large, matters and is received with gratitude.
give.s2_p: The ways to give (during worship, by mobile money, by transfer) will be set out here. We will never show a number or account before it has been verified with the treasurer: your trust matters more than speed.
give.s3_p: We want to explain simply what gifts are used for, and to report on their use to the community.

privacy.lead: Your privacy matters. Here, simply, is what this site keeps about you, why, and how to take control. Provisional text: [À VALIDER] by the Parish Council before launch.
privacy.s1_p: If you simply visit the site, we keep nothing about you: no tracking cookie, no analytics tool, no advertising. If you create an account in “My space”, we keep the information listed below, and only that.
privacy.s2_p: The EEC Nkolndongo 1 parish (Evangelical Church of Cameroon), in Yaoundé. The person to contact about your data will be named here: [À VALIDER: name and contact].
privacy.s3_t: What we keep if you have an account
privacy.l1: Your name, your email address and, if you wish, your phone number.
privacy.l2: If you sign in with Google: your Google name, email address and profile picture, nothing else.
privacy.l3: The parish groups you say you take part in (optional).
privacy.l4: Your agreements (privacy policy, parish news), with the date and the version of the text you accepted.
privacy.l5: Your language and theme, and the list of your current sign-ins (device and date) so you can close them.
privacy.s4_p: To give you a personal space and, if you choose, to send you the parish news later. We only ask for what we need, and your agreement is never ticked in advance.
privacy.l6: Authorised parish team members (for example the secretariat), according to their role. Every sensitive access is logged.
privacy.l7: Our technical providers, who run the site: Cloudflare (hosting), Neon (database, in Europe) and Google if you choose to sign in with Google.
privacy.l8: No one else. We do not sell or rent any information, and we make no advertising from it.
privacy.l9: Your account: while it is active. If you ask for it to be deleted, you have 30 days to change your mind, then everything is erased.
privacy.l10: Sign-ins: 30 days at most. Messages waiting to be sent: 90 days.
privacy.l11: The administration activity log (who did what): 24 months.
privacy.s7_p: In “My space” you can view and correct your details, withdraw your agreement to the news, download a copy of your data and delete your account. For anything else, write to the person named above.
privacy.s8_p: A single cookie, needed for signing in (“session”), exists while you are signed in. Your theme and language choices are kept in your browser. No tracking cookie.
privacy.s9_p: We comply with Cameroonian law no. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection. [À VALIDER: contact of the data protection authority.]
privacy.s10_p: Version 2026-10-brouillon. If this text changes, we will tell you and ask for your agreement again.
